healthy.name: Healthy Leaf
healthy.advice: Your coffee plant looks healthy! Continue good practices.
prevention: Monitor plants weekly for early disease detection
Apply organic mulch and compost annually
Use drip irrigation to keep leaves dry

cercospora.name: Brown Eye Spot (Cercospora)
cercospora.description: Fungal disease causing brown circular spots with gray centers

organic: Remove and burn infected fallen leaves
Prune overcrowded branches for air circulation
conventional: Spray when spots first appear, repeat after 14 days

actions: Intensive spray program: every 7 days for 8 weeks

prevention: Apply preventive copper spray before rainy season

leaf_rust.name: Coffee Leaf Rust
leaf_rust.description: Most damaging coffee disease - orange powdery pustules on leaf undersides
leaf_rust.urgency: HIGH - Act within 5-7 days to prevent rapid spread

organic: Copper hydroxide spray every 21 days (2.5-3 g/L)
Remove and burn infected leaves weekly

severe.urgent: EMERGENCY - Contact district agricultural office within 24 hours
critical_actions: Stump heavily defoliated plants (>60% leaf loss)
Expect 50-70% yield loss this year without treatment
severe.cost_warning: Treatment expensive (15,000-25,000 Birr/ha) but necessary to save plantation

prevention: MOST IMPORTANT: Preventive fungicide program (2,000-4,000 Birr/ha/year)
Weekly scouting during rainy season - early detection is critical
Spray before rainy season starts (Late May in Ethiopia)
leaf_rust.disease_spread: Spreads exponentially - a few leaves can become plantation-wide in 4-6 weeks

phoma.name: Phoma Leaf Spot
phoma.description: Dark brown lesions with lighter centers, typically less severe

moderate: Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil spray every 14-21 days

prevention: Proper drainage to avoid waterlogged soil
Avoid wounding plants during field work
Maintain plant vigor with balanced nutrition

general_advice.safety: Always wear gloves, mask, and protective clothing when applying fungicides
general_advice.resistance: Rotate different fungicide types to prevent resistance
general_advice.support: Contact your local agricultural extension office for subsidies and technical support
